tools.name: search_jobs
tools.description: Search live jobs on Haystack, newest first. Filter by job title words, country, city, remote, and by what the advert says: no experience needed, no degree needed, visa sponsorship offered. Returns up to 20 jobs, each with its link, and an Auto Apply link when Haystack's AI agent can fill in and submit the employer's form.

query.description: Words in the job title, e.g. 'product manager', 'nurse', 'data analyst'.

country.description: Country name or code, e.g. 'United States', 'UK', 'Canada', 'Germany'.

no_experience.description: Only roles whose advert says no experience is needed or training is provided.

no_degree.description: Only roles whose advert says no degree is needed (or asks for a high school diploma or equivalent).

visa_sponsorship.description: Only roles whose advert says the employer offers visa sponsorship.

auto_apply_only.description: Only roles Haystack's AI agent can apply to.

tools.name: get_job
tools.description: One job's details by its Haystack id: title, employer, location, pay, work mode, skills, what the advert says (no experience, no degree, visa sponsorship), the description, and facts about applying to that employer from Haystack's data (reply rate, time to reply, form questions) when known.

tools.name: employer_facts
tools.description: What Haystack knows about applying to an employer: live roles, the share of applications that got a reply, the median time to the first reply, how many fields its form has and the questions it asks. Pass no company to get the employers most likely to reply to an application.

company.description: Employer name, e.g. 'Monzo', 'Stripe'. Leave out for the employers most likely to reply.

tools.name: application_system_facts
tools.description: Facts about an application system (ATS) from applications Haystack's AI agent sent: how many fields its forms have, the questions they ask most, and how fast employers on it reply. Without a system, the overall figures.
